obfuscation_indicators: risks, uncertainties, assumptions and other factors
risk_summary: The excerpt provides broad disclosure of supply-chain, inflation, inventory, backlog, integration, geopolitical, regulatory, and pandemic risks, but many impacts remain unquantified and are framed through extensive forward-looking disclaimers. Management expresses confidence in restructuring and transformation initiatives, while acknowledging that persistent cost pressures and normalization of demand could weaken results. Debt-servicing capacity depends on subsidiary dividends and may be constrained by statutory or regulatory limitations.
